Name: ERRORcauser's Farmhouse and Stable Alternative Textures Conversion
Author: TerraTerraCotta
Description:
I had this sitting around because I wanted ERRORcauser's permission before converting, however they never responded and I was asked to convert this mod, so I've gone ahead decided to release my conversion. If the mod author wants me to remove it, please ask and I will

This is an Alternative Textures Conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1210]Farmhouses and Stable Appearance[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures.[/url]

This comes with all three Farmhouse and stable colors for each level of Farmhouse upgrade, and should be paintable. It is also searchable under Errorcauser or by color.

I lightly tested the mod before uploading to make sure it works, but if there's any issues please leave a comment and I'll see if I can fix it

[i][b]DISCLAIMER: [/b]If the original mod author wishes me to take this down, or wishes to update the original mod with the alternative texture pack I've created. They are welcome to DM me and I can accomodate. [/i]
